title: Multilevel Adaptive-Rank Methods for Linear and Nonlinear Systems in the Hierarchical Tucker Format
summary: We develop multilevel adaptive-rank iterative methods for the solution of linear and nonlinear systems arising from high-dimensional partial differential equations. Our contributions are threefold. First, we extend the projection method of Ballani and Grasedyck [6] to enable flexible preconditioning of high-dimensional linear systems in low-rank tensor formats. Second, we construct multilevel preconditioning strategies by adapting geometric multigrid methods to the low-rank setting.
